title: Macrame Workshop
description: Discover the therapeutic art of knotting in this hands-on Macramé Workshop hosted by Artified Nepal, designed to unlock your inner creativity. In this engaging 3-hour session, absolute beginners will learn foundational knotting techniques and step-by-step pattern creation under expert guidance. The registration fee covers all premium crafting materials—including high-quality cotton cords and wooden dowels—allowing you to relax, connect with fellow creatives, and take home your very own handmade boho-chic masterpiece ready to decorate your space.

title: Pearl Bag Making Workshop
description: Ever wanted to learn how to make these gorgeous pearl bags? We are here to help you! Come join our hands-on couture masterclass led by Sahina Shrestha. Learn intricate 3D pearl lattice beading, structured bridal clutch framing, ergonomic artisan handle assembly, and satin interior finishing with all raw materials provided.

title: Pipe Cleaner Sunflower Workshop
description:
In this 3-hour workshop, participants will be engaged in creating a sunflower using pipe cleaners. The session is designed to be fun, relaxed, and hands-on, allowing everyone to explore shapes, colors, and simple techniques at their own pace.

No prior experience is needed—All the materials will be provided. Just come ready to twist, create, and enjoy the process of turning basic materials into a bright, handmade sunflower to take home. 🌻
